title: CCP SpaceX Crew-12 Launch (KSC-20260213-MH-CSH01-0001-CCP SpaceX Crew 12 Launch Clips-M19013)
description: A high speed recording captures liftoff of NASA’s SpaceX Crew-12 mission SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket with a Dragon spacecraft at 5:15 a.m. EST Friday, Feb. 13, 2026, from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida. NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway, ESA (European Space Agency) astronaut Sophie Adenot, and Roscosmos cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev launched to the International Space Station for a long duration mission as part of NASA’s Commercial Crew Program.
